title: Every Pup Home
text: Captain Pom flew home with every lost puppy riding on her back and a sack of squeaky toys in her paws.
Every pup was back in its own yard before dinner. The neighborhood threw a block party. The Empress came too, and brought the hedgehog.
That night, Maya found Pom asleep by the door, paws twitching, dreaming of flying.

title: The Neighborhood Sleeps Soundly
text: The Feline Armada has been booped back to their beds, and the squeaky toys are home.
A few puppies are still finding their way back, but Commander Biscuit has search parties out, and the Empress has promised to help.
That night, Maya found Pom asleep by the door, paws twitching, dreaming of flying.
